watches: the market, not us — the first agent in this fleet pointed outward
discipline: Unusual is not the same as meaningful. Everything is a READ, every finding says how much history it is judging against, and too little history produces an honest refusal rather than manufactured significance.

findings.what: Chilling Reign Booster Pack moved 13.1% — about 4.9× its own typical daily swing.
findings.why: Measured against its own 15 days of history, not against other products. A product that normally moves a lot is not flagged for moving a lot.

findings.what: Paldean Fates Booster Pack moved 10.1% — about 8.0× its own typical daily swing.
findings.why: Measured against its own 13 days of history, not against other products. A product that normally moves a lot is not flagged for moving a lot.
